tool_args.rationale: The matched-endpoint history gap and transient lag favor a coupled memory ODE. Finer trajectories can resolve the fast transient and help distinguish memory decay from coupling strength before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the two-state memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five forecast targets span similar horizons, and every initial memory state must be reconstructed from a short prefix. That leaves the memory time constant and coupling weakly separated.
It cannot explain different forecasts from matched endpoints with different histories.
It targets branch ambiguity rather than the observed memory lag.
